messages:
anne: ran the mallard11b bring-up smoke this morning — quick hit: int6 looks close to int8 on short completions but is much cheaper. posting numbers, want a recommendation for product/GTN rollout.

raj: thanks. i ran three slices: short (<40 toks), medium (40-200), long (>200). quick table from the smoke (avg over 1k requests each):

```
Model | qps | p95 latency | unit_cost_per_1k_tokens
mallard11b-int6 | 320 | 210ms | $0.013
mallard11b-int8 | 300 | 190ms | $0.018
mallard7b-int4  | 460 | 140ms | $0.009
```

raj: quality: on short completions (user prompts in prod) int6 ~= int8 (delta ~0.2% accept rate). on longform generation int8 wins (1.3-1.6% QA metric uplift).

maria: product note — main GTN flows are short completions (autocomplete, descriptions) ~88% of instances; longform is edge-case ~7-10%. so cost wins matter.

lucas: operationally i propose hybrid routing by request size + a cheap fallback. something like: 

```
routing:
  - match: {max_tokens: 40} -> mallard11b-int6
  - match: {min_tokens: 41} -> mallard11b-int8
  - fallback: mallard7b-int4
```

lucas: also set canary: start 5% traffic -> int6 primary, watch quality signals and latency tail.

zoe: heads-up: int6 had a cold KV cache p95 spike in the 2nd run when batch sizes hit 64. we should warm the pool or set min_instances for critical flows. reproduce command: `runtest --coldstart --concurrency=100 mallard-smoke`

anne: good catch. can we add a short warmstart script and pin min_instances=2 for GTN routes?

raj: yep. warmstart script (works locally):

```
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/models/mallard11b/int6/infer -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}' >/dev/null; done
```

raj: estimated unit-econ impact if we adopt int6 primary with int8 for longform (~10%): approx 30-35% token-cost savings vs always int8. with fallback to 7b-int4 for low-quality-tolerance flows we can bump to ~40% overall.

maria: product okay with that as long as longform users keep int8. can we add a GTN flag so specific customers get int8 by default?

lucas: yes — suggest route-level override + rollout flag. also recommend metric alerts: GTN_accept_rate_drop > 0.5% and p95_latency_increase > 40ms.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: mallard-int6 routing rule change -> canary at 5% at 2026-04-03T16:00Z (note: timestamp simulated).

anne: tl;dr & action items: 
- recommend: make mallard11b-int6 the primary for short completions (<=40 toks).
- keep mallard11b-int8 for longform (>40 toks) and a per-customer override flag.
- add fallback mallard7b-int4 for explicitly low-cost flows.
- warmstart script + min_instances=2 for GTN routes to avoid cold p95 spikes.
- canary rollout 5% then 25% -> monitor GTN_accept_rate, downsampled human eval, and p95 latency.

anne: assigning: raj -> finalize smoke numbers and add to scorecard, lucas -> implement routing config & rollout playbook, zoe -> run coldstart tail tests and report, maria -> confirm product OK for flag + customer list. :thumbsup:

maria: ack. will compile customer list and flag rules.

lucas: starting routing PR now.

zoe: running coldstart sweeps, will post results by EOD.

raj: updated smoke artifacts in the bench bucket: s3://bench/mallard/smoke-7088881111.csv

anne: thanks everyone. we’ll re-evaluate after canary metrics stabilize.
